markets.rules_secondary:
Market resolves Yes if:
The game officially takes place at a physical venue located within Rio de Janeiro before Sep 28, 2026
The game begins in Rio de Janeiro before Sep 28, 2026 even if the end of the game occurs elsewhere

Market resolves No if:
The game is cancelled entirely
The game is postponed beyond Sep 28, 2026
The game begins in a different geographical location other than Rio de Janeiro
